subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve omitted allowBots as accept-all for bot-authored messages, or require a more restrictive explicit mode before this bot-to-bot feature lands?
rationale: The code can support either policy, but the default changes the upgrade posture for live Feishu groups and cannot be settled by tests alone.

options.title: Preserve Current Admission
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu messages, relying on the self-filter and shared loop guard after the branch is refreshed and the small breaker issue is fixed.

options.title: Require Mention-Only Default
options.body: Change the default toward allowBots="mentions" or require explicit allowBots=true, reducing loop exposure but potentially breaking existing bot-authored Feishu flows.

options.title: Pause Bot-To-Bot Bundling
options.body: Hold or close this bundled-core PR if maintainers want Feishu bot-to-bot behavior to wait for a narrower channel policy decision.

recommendation.title: Preserve Current Admission
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu messages, relying on the self-filter and shared loop guard after the branch is refreshed and the small breaker issue is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest history across Feishu routing/config policy and is the best available owner for the default-admission decision.
